descriptions.text: Enchanted Nipple Ring of the Defiler This may only be equipped on a crawler who has been Marked for Death by a god. Hey, that’s you! All nipple rings must be manually affixed the first time they are equipped. Wearing this ring imbues the following effects: Instantly know the religious affiliation of all nearby mobs and crawlers. Allows the destruction of church shrines without further ill effects from deities. +25% damage against all clerics. The ability to cast Black Nimbus once an hour.

recap.text: Carl wins a silver nipple ring with an eyeball hanging from it, a platinum apostate box prize for not getting killed by Diwata. When Ogun comes for his worshippers Paz and Anton, Carl casts its spell, Black Nimbus, on Anton and reads a Heal scroll on each man. A black crown forms over Anton's head, but Ogun says it removed only protection and mercy, not wrath, and crushes him.

beats.headline: The apostate's box
beats.text: The platinum apostate box, earned for not getting killed by Diwata, holds a ring. A nipple ring. Donut is triumphant: now that his nipples are full, there are other places he is not pierced yet. It is silver, with an eyeball hanging from it, and only a crawler marked for death by a god may wear it. Li Na could already do everything it does. Its spell, Black Nimbus, pulls a target out of their deity's blessing and keeps them out of church. Lots of divinity-themed items, says Mordecai, and that is never good.
beats.gist: Carl's platinum apostate box holds a ring only a god-marked crawler may wear.

beats.headline: Black Nimbus on Anton
beats.text: Ogun has come for his two worshippers, Paz and Anton, and has eyes only for them. Carl's new ring came with Black Nimbus, which removes the benefits of worshipping a god, and maybe it would save them from a smite, but it reaches only one. He steps forward and casts it on Anton, then reads a Heal scroll on each man. A black crown forms over Anton's head, and the shunned mark disappears. The god turns, more curious than angry. A good attempt, he says: it has removed the man from his protection and his mercy, not from his wrath. He steps back onto Anton's head and crushes him.
beats.gist: Carl casts Black Nimbus on Anton and heals both men, but Ogun still crushes Anton underfoot.
